name: Shinseiki Evangelion Koutetsu no Girlfriend
original_name: 新世紀エヴァンゲリオン鋼鉄のガールフレンド
source:
A shy female character, Mana Kirishima, starts at Shinji Ikari's school and immediately admits to finding him cute. Gradually, a relationship unfolds and they end up going on a date. It turns out, however, that she is one of three test pilots for the TRIDENT units, a new competitor to the Evangelions, similar to Jet Alone; thus the name Girlfriend of Steel.

[Edited from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Girlfriend_of_Steel]Wikipedia[/url]]
translation:
性格腼腆的少女雾岛真名转入碇真嗣所在的学校，一见面便坦率地说他很可爱。两人的关系逐渐发展，最后还一同约会。然而，真名其实是TRIDENT机体的三名测试驾驶员之一。TRIDENT是EVA的新竞争对手，与JET ALONE相似，作品标题《钢铁女友》也由此而来。

[编辑自[url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Girlfriend_of_Steel]Wikipedia[/url]]
